test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the central theme of the passage.

options.text: For peace and economic well-being, man should not harm animals.
As GDP growth depends on animals, we should replace them.
Animals and humans should come to an agreement to live together.
Forest protection should be taken care of by the governments.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights the drastic decline in wildlife populations due to human activities in the Anthropocene era.
 
• It discusses the significant economic implications of losing wildlife, as a large portion of the world's GDP depends on ecosystem services provided by animals.
 
• The passage suggests solutions such as rejuvenating wild habitats and protecting animals to prevent further loss.
 
• Option 1 captures the essence of these points by emphasizing the importance of not harming animals for both peace and economic well-being.

Thus, the central theme of the passage is best reflected in **Option 1: "For peace and economic well-being, man should not harm animals."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "As GDP growth depends on animals, we should replace them"** – Incorrect as the passage suggests protecting animals, not replacing them.
 
• **Option 3: "Animals and humans should come to an agreement to live together"** – While this is suggested, it is not the central theme of the passage.
 
• **Option 4: "Forest protection should be taken care of by the governments"** – This is a component of the solution, but not the central theme of the passage.
